page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.hfc9i.24xlarge is a compute-optimized instance built on the KVM hypervisor. It features 96 dedicated vCPUs powered by an Intel Xeon 6982P-C processor operating at a base frequency of 3.4 GHz. The system architecture is x86_64. It is configured with 192.0 GB of system memory, yielding a memory-to-core ratio of 2.0 GB per vCPU.

This instance does not include local NVMe storage or integrated GPU hardware, meaning all storage requirements must be met via external network-attached block storage. Network connectivity is supported by a baseline bandwidth of 48 Gbps. The lack of local storage and GPUs represents a clear tradeoff, optimizing the instance specifically for pure CPU-bound workloads rather than data-intensive storage operations or hardware-accelerated machine learning tasks.

From a cost-efficiency perspective, the 1:2 memory-to-vCPU ratio ensures that users do not pay a premium for unutilized memory when running compute-heavy applications. This resource profile is highly suitable for high-performance computing, batch processing, intensive web serving, and CPU-based simulation workloads that require high clock speeds and dedicated CPU allocation without massive memory footprints.
